---
title: Fluid Typography
description: Responsive typography system and custom fonts.
---

Rimelight UI features a fluid typography scale that automatically adjusts font sizes based on the viewport width, ensuring optimal readability on all screen sizes.

## Font Families

- **Sans**: Noto Sans (default)
- **Serif**: Noto Serif (default)
- **Mono**: JetBrains Mono / Noto Sans Mono (default)
